research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your bedroom into a sanctuary of faith with this beautifully designed Christian bedding set from Jeminise. Featuring inspiring Bible verses and uplifting accents, this comforter set makes a perfect and meaningful gift for the special women in your life, whether for birthdays, special occasions, or simply as a constant reminder of faith and love.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: An inspirational Christian bedding set, perfect for Mom, Daughter, or Sister, ideal for birthdays or special occasions.
  • Product Type: Choose between a duvet cover (no filling insert) or a comforter for all-in-one warmth and convenience.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each package includes 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter and optional Pillowcases.
  • Material Details: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Comforter includes whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Pattern Letter Print
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Care Instructions Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat
